name: gridpoint-and-block-fixity
full_name: Gridpoint and Rigid-Block Fixity / Prescribed Motion
description: Constrain or drive motion at gridpoints (deformable blocks) with 'block gridpoint apply', and at rigid blocks with 'block fix' / 'block apply'. Velocity/force here are the workhorse mechanical BCs. A 'range' is REQUIRED on 'block gridpoint apply <condition> <value>' — omitting it is rejected with 'A range must be specified' (live 9.7.47).
verification: Live enumeration (9.7) of 'block gridpoint apply': apply apply-remove fish force force-x force-y force-z group initialize list quiet quiet-x quiet-y quiet-z range reaction reaction-normal reaction-x reaction-y reaction-z source table temperature trace velocity velocity-normal velocity-x velocity-y velocity-z verbose viscous viscous-x viscous-y viscous-z
Live enumeration (9.7) of 'block gridpoint subcommands': apply apply-remove group initialize list trace
Live enumeration (9.7) of 'block fix': range rotation rotation-x rotation-y rotation-z velocity velocity-x velocity-y velocity-z

The 'block gridpoint apply' enumeration is context-free (identical under thermal/dynamic/fluid configure): quiet/viscous (dynamic), temperature (thermal) and source (fluid) are always visible — see thermal-and-dynamic and fluid-flow.
There is NO 'block gridpoint history' subcommand (live 9.7 rejects it) — sample gridpoint quantities via 'block history <field> gridpointid <i>'.
notes: Applying a velocity fixes that component; use 0 to pin a boundary.
'reaction' reports/holds the reaction force at constrained gridpoints; 'reaction-normal' (live-enumerated) is the face-normal variant.

'block apply velocity ...' drives rigid-block translation. Live 'block apply' enumeration: fish range table velocity velocity-x velocity-y velocity-z — the value can also come from a 'fish' function or 'table'.
